primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 歴代誌上2:3は、ユダの三人の子が「カナン人シュアの娘」から生まれたと記します。妻本人の名はこの節に記されず、シュアはその父として示されます。
primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
